_meta.keys: 5e damage type; 'default' = fallback for any unmapped type
_meta.timing: ms. grow = head/projectile travels A->B, hold = full line, fade. Bloom (and fire burst) start at t=grow; suggest impactDelay = type.grow (today spell = 180). Force: last front arrives at grow + frontGap*(fronts-1).
_meta.colors: 'r,g,b' strings used as rgba(${c},alpha) like the demo
_meta.owner: Effects toggle, fog/hidden-caster rules and sync stay with Coder (map/ssdns-map-fx.js)

shapes.jag: seeded random lateral offsets * amp * sin(PI*u), flicker, one fork
shapes.ball: radial-gradient ball + trail of trailN radial-gradient discs (no polyline)
shapes.front: N arc() strokes (glow/core/hot) travelling A->B + faint wake line
shapes.shard: filled diamond polygon + radial glow, mist-disc trail, falling flakes, impact spoke lines
shapes.tube: wide breathing glow stroke on a bow + thin core + 4-point sparkles
shapes.beads: N radial-gradient discs on a bowed path, staggered
shapes.glob: lumpy polygon blob (dark source-over body + green sheen) on a slight lob; drip lines + droplet discs; tiny bubble rings; impact = puddle ellipse + ballistic droplets + bloom rings
shapes.cloud: staggered clusters of soft radial discs (flat falloff) with a faint source-over murk; two curling thin wisps; impact = lingering billow of discs (no hard rings)
shapes.tendril: curling polyline: wide plum glow, then a dark source-over core, then a thin bone line; two short curling offshoots; ash flakes (grey additive + dark source-over); impact = dark disc + CONTRACTING wobbly rings
shapes.mote: gold radial-disc mote on an upward lob with a rotating 4-point glint, thin gold trail, twinkling glints left behind; impact = vertical light shaft dropping onto the target + glint + bloom rings
shapes.mindring: chain of slightly oval, pulsing ring polylines travelling A->B on a fine wavy thread; impact = 3 gently wavy expanding rings
shapes.cone: filled wedge polygon from caster (source-over dust + faint additive glow), soft leading-edge arc, grit specks; impact = 3 thick dusty rings (source-over) with gold edges + flung debris specks

_meta.showAt: review-sheet only: fraction of grow used for the hero frame
_meta.blend_note: Additive = globalCompositeOperation 'lighter'. Fields named under/dust/dark are drawn with 'source-over' (normal) BEFORE or between additive passes to get smoke, dust and murk that can darken the map.

default.vibe: Standard magic: two smooth strands, violet and Eldorite teal, twist around each other like a ribbon. No forks, no flicker.

fire.vibe: Fire Bolt: a white-hot ball of flame flies the path, a tongue of fire and embers streaming behind it, then a fire burst on impact.

cold.vibe: Frost shard: a slow white-ice spear tip leaves a pale cold-mist trail and falling frost, then cracks into a rime star on impact.

lightning.vibe: Storm on the prairie: jagged blue-violet bolt, white-hot core, fast in and fast out with a flicker.

force.vibe: Raw Eldorite push: three curved teal wave fronts roll from caster to target and slam into a triple ring.

acid.vibe: Lye glob: a lumpy green-yellow glob lobs over, hissing and dripping, then splashes and leaves a smoking puddle.

poison.vibe: Bad-water miasma: slow, murky yellow-olive cloud puffs and curling wisps drift over and billow around the target.

necrotic.vibe: Grave smoke: a black-plum tendril curls to the target, shedding ash, and the light collapses inward on impact.

radiant.vibe: Sunday sun: a bright gold mote arcs over shedding holy glints, then a shaft of light drops onto the target.

psychic.vibe: A migraine you can see: a chain of wobbly dusty-magenta mind-rings pulses to the target, then wavy rings ripple out.

thunder.vibe: Canyon thunderclap: a dusty grey-gold shock cone punches out, then a big dirt-brown boom ring and flung grit.

named_overrides._note: Placeholders are not designed. Candidates are the default options Jessey did not pick; unassigned until he ties them to a spell.

override_b_haze_tube.label: haze tube
override_b_haze_tube.vibe: A soft, slowly pulsing violet haze tube on a gentle bow with a thin teal thread and Eldorite sparkles.
assigned_to: mage armor (fallback until Jessey picks shell vs tube)

override_c_arcane_beads.label: arcane beads
override_c_arcane_beads.vibe: A string of soft violet beads with teal hearts glides along a curved path and pops into the target, one by one.

override_d_s_curve.label: smooth S-curve
override_d_s_curve.vibe: One slow, thick S-curve of violet haze with a soft teal core that sways gently. Thicker and softer than lightning.

shield.note: ghostly heater + tin-star hint on caster

pact shot.note: spectral bullet + smoke rings; EB stays S-curve

mage armor.note: six plates + vapor wreath; haze tube fallback kept

ghostly_shield.label: Shield — ghostly heater shield
ghostly_shield.vibe: A translucent heater shield with a faint tin star snaps up in front of the caster, glows Eldorite teal with a violet rim, then fades.

ethereal_bullet.label: Pact Shot — ethereal bullet
ethereal_bullet.vibe: A spectral violet cartridge with a teal halo streaks out like a gunshot on a hairline trail, shedding ghost smoke-rings, then a soft arcane bloom.

ghost_armor_shell.label: Mage Armor — ghost-armor shell
ghost_armor_shell.vibe: Six translucent armor plates close in around the caster into a slowly turning second-skin shell, shimmer once, then settle out.

default_retired_v1.vibe: Today's generic spell line: violet haze, Eldorite-teal core. Fallback for any unmapped type.

smoke._note: Black-powder puff at the shooter's muzzle (origin = token centre + dir * muzzleOffsetR * tokenRadius). Source-over soft discs, light then shade. Obeys Effects on/off and fog (Coder).

black_powder_revolver.label: Gun smoke — revolver
black_powder_revolver.vibe: Light grey-brown black-powder puff at the muzzle, drifts forward and up, gone in under a second.

black_powder_buck.label: Gun smoke — shotgun / buck
black_powder_buck.vibe: A wider, slightly bigger powder cloud for buck: still light and short so tokens stay readable.

self_smoke._note: Self-cast vapors, drawn on the caster only. Source-over soft discs (+ a faint additive edge for the Shield curl).

mage_armor_wreath.label: Self smoke — Mage Armor wreath
mage_armor_wreath.vibe: A soft pale-grey wreath of vapor circles the caster once and thins outward.

shield_pop_curl.label: Self smoke — Shield pop curl
shield_pop_curl.vibe: A brief charcoal smoke curl with a violet edge twists up off the shield as it pops.

pwt_ground_veil.label: Self smoke — Pass without Trace veil
pwt_ground_veil.vibe: A low, flat dust-brown haze rolls out at boot height around the party and settles.

utility_concepts._status: concept sketches only; not designed in full, not locked

pass_without_trace.label: Pass without Trace
pass_without_trace.vibe: A muted dust veil dims the party, and their bootprints fade behind them.

invisibility.label: Invisibility
invisibility.vibe: The token dissolves into a cool heat-shimmer: vertical ripples, rising specks, then gone.

healing_word.label: Healing Word / Cure Wounds
healing_word.vibe: A soft green-gold pulse on the target with rising warm motes. Gentle, not a radiant shaft.

bless.label: Bless
bless.vibe: Small gold sun-marks flicker over each blessed ally's head with a faint gold ring at their feet.

fog_cloud.label: Fog Cloud
fog_cloud.vibe: A grey mist bank rolls in over a 20-ft circle; soft lumpy edge, mostly opaque.

mage_hand.label: Mage Hand
mage_hand.vibe: A faint spectral glove drifts out from the caster on a trail of teal motes.
